summary.text: Nathan Coulter is a Democratic member of the Minnesota House of Representatives from District 51B, in office since 2023, and is on the ballot for re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election. Republican Jim Lund is also on the general election ballot.

paragraphs.text: Nathan Coulter was born in and lives in Bloomington, Minnesota, and earned a B.A. in political science and music from St. Olaf College in 2008 and an M.P.A. from the University of Minnesota's Humphrey School of Public Affairs in 2019.

His career experience includes working as a legislative assistant and then researcher at the Minnesota State Senate and as housing and redevelopment authority commissioner for the City of Bloomington, and he also served on the Bloomington City Council.
Coulter defeated Republican Lion Johnson in the November 5, 2024 general election for the seat.

Coulter's 2025-2026 committee assignments included Children and Families Finance and Policy, Elections Finance and Policy, the House Higher Education Finance and Policy Committee (as Co-Vice Chair), and the Rules and Legislative Administration Committee.
